content: स्थानिन् {%a.%} [स्थानमस्यास्ति रक्ष्यत्वेन इनि] .²1 Having a place. .²2 Having fixedness, permanent. .²3 Having a substitute. --{%m.%} .²1 The original form or primitive element, that for which anything else is substituted; स्थानिवदादेशोऽनल्विधौ <ls>P. I. 1. 56</ls>. .²2 The form so substituted for anything. .²3 That which has a place, or is actually expressed.
